findings.message: `## Depends on` names `serve-test-rig`, but there is no tickets/serve-test-rig/ directory and no commit has touched one. tests/integration/serve_rig.py does not exist on main. Scope in requires each new file to import its helpers from `tests.integration.serve_rig`. The kill tests need `HeldLLM`, `active_graph`, `trip`, `script`, `graph`, `until`, `finish`, `request` and `terminals`; the lifecycle tests need `write`, `orphan` re-exports and the rest. Without merged code or an authored dependency, no reviewer can confirm those names will exist under that module. Until they do, the implementer would have to edit serve_rig.py, which this ticket's Scope out forbids.
findings.paved_road: Author and merge `serve-test-rig` first. It should create tests/integration/serve_rig.py with every non-test helper from test_serve.py, and repoint test_serve.py and the 10 external importers (test_heartbeat, test_watchdog_activation, test_provider_cooldown_failover, test_hostfiles, test_daemon_composition, test_kill_worker_stop, test_kill_failure_suppression, test_checkpoint, test_daemon_tasks, test_merge) to it. Then rerun `chupa review` on this ticket against the merged serve_rig.py.

findings.message: Several helpers sit between the tests in `test_serve.py` and are used only by tests this ticket moves: `admission_config` (line 1287), `notify_command`, `deliveries`, `notify_completions`, and `escalation_batch` (lines 1503-1540). The ticket forbids changes to `serve_rig.py` and says only 'imports its helpers from serve_rig'. If `serve-test-rig` does not move these helpers, the implementer has to choose between moving them into the new files (which may count as a helper change) and leaving them in `test_serve.py` with cross-test-file imports. The ticket settles neither.

## Context
- tests/integration/test_serve.py

## Goal / Why
`tests/integration/test_serve.py` is about 95,000 characters because every serve ticket appends to it. A ticket that embeds it in `## Context` uses a third of the 300,000-character authoring headroom on this one file: `retro-request-serve` rendered 328,574 characters and `chupa review` refused it (2026-11-08). The single-ticket move `split-test-serve` went over the 1,500-inserted-line diff budget, so the move lands in four steps. This last step moves the remaining tests and deletes `test_serve.py`.

This is a pure move. No test's body, parameters, or assertions change.

## Scope in / Scope out
- In: create `tests/integration/test_serve_upgrade.py` and move into it, unchanged: `test_upgrade_after_real_merge`, `test_external_engine_change_at_admission`, `test_upgrade_waits_for_continuation`, `test_non_git_engine_disables_upgrade`, `test_kill_accepted_during_upgrade_cleanup_prevents_spawn`, `test_stop_finishes_merge_without_admitting_next_or_spawning`.
- In: create `tests/integration/test_serve_dispatch.py` and move into it, unchanged: `test_refused_uncommitted_bug_does_not_stop_serve`, `test_dispatch_republishes_ticket_changed_after_publication`, `test_live_keep_dispatches_again_without_restart`, `test_serve_reoffers_failed_dispatch_with_machine_keep_and_retry`, `test_serve_premise_reoffer_draws_no_retry`, `test_serve_reoffers_merge_failure`, `test_requested_retro_waits_for_idle_then_resumes`, `test_kill_aborts_requested_retro`, `test_automatic_retro_runs_at_idle_when_due`, `test_automatic_retro_off_when_disabled`, `test_failed_retro_does_not_reblock`. Also move into it unchanged any other test still left in `test_serve.py`.
- In: each new file imports its helpers from `tests.integration.serve_rig` (created by `serve-test-rig`). It imports the `root` fixture and any other names its tests use the same way `test_serve.py` does.
- In: delete `tests/integration/test_serve.py`.
- Out:
  - any change to a test body, parametrization, or helper behavior;
  - any change to `tests/integration/serve_rig.py` or to the test files created by `serve-tests-lifecycle-kill` and `serve-tests-admission-notify`;
  - any file outside `tests/integration/`.

4. No file under `tests/` imports from `tests.integration.test_serve`. Check: `grep -rn "tests.integration.test_serve import" tests` finds nothing.
